full_text_en:
AgrEvo Company v. Nanjing No. 1 Pesticide Factory — Trademark Infringement Dispute

**Plaintiff:** Hoechst Schering AgrEvo Co., Ltd. Domicile: 163 Gambetta Street, 75020 Paris, France.

**Legal Representative:** Ke Luo'er Alan, President of the Company.

**Agent ad litem:** Yang Hongzhi, Legal Counsel of Hoechst Schering AgrEvo Tianjin Co., Ltd.

**Defendant:** Nanjing No. 1 Pesticide Factory, Jiangsu Province. Domicile: 269 Baota Road, Chunxi Town, Gaochun County, Jiangsu Province.

**Legal Representative:** Yang Shouhai, Factory Director.

**Agent ad litem:** Chen Guirong, Lawyer of Nanjing Jinghu Law Office, Jiangsu Province.

**Agent ad litem:** Wang Xiaoping, Manager of the Quality and Technical Supervision Department of Nanjing No. 1 Pesticide Factory, Jiangsu Province.

The plaintiff, Hoechst Schering AgrEvo Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as AgrEvo Company), filed a lawsuit with the Nanjing Intermediate People's Court of Jiangsu Province against the defendant, Nanjing No. 1 Pesticide Factory, Jiangsu Province (hereinafter referred to as Nanjing No. 1 Factory), concerning a trademark infringement dispute.

**Plaintiff's Allegations:** The plaintiff is currently the owner of the exclusive right to use the registered "Cotton Boll" trademark in China. Without the plaintiff's permission, the defendant, on the outer packaging of 98% deltamethrin technical concentrate and 2.5% deltamethrin emulsifiable concentrate (200 liters) (the technical material for manufacturing the insecticide "Decis") produced and sold by it, used the plaintiff's registered "Cotton Boll" trademark. The defendant's conduct has constituted infringement upon the plaintiff's exclusive right to use the trademark, caused serious damage to the plaintiff's sales market, and caused the plaintiff substantial economic losses. The plaintiff requests the court to: order the defendant to immediately cease the infringing act; publish an apology to the plaintiff in the news media to eliminate the adverse effects; compensate the plaintiff for economic losses of RMB 3,000,000; and bear the litigation costs of this case.

To support its claims, the plaintiff, AgrEvo Company, submitted not only the label bearing the "Cotton Boll" pattern and signed "Red Sun Group Nanjing No. 1 Pesticide Factory" found on the 98% deltamethrin technical concentrate, but also the audit report dated August 20, 1998, issued by Tianjin Xietong Accounting Firm. The report stated that the sales revenue of AgrEvo Tianjin Co., Ltd. from January to July 1998 decreased by 21.3% compared to the same period of the previous year, a decrease of RMB 16,442,084.93. During the litigation, AgrEvo Company requested to add Red Sun Group Co., Ltd. as a defendant in this case.

**Defendant's Defense:** From 1990 to 1997, the plaintiff and the defendant were business partners. The defendant processed the "Decis" technical material produced by the plaintiff into 2.5% "Decis" emulsifiable concentrate. During this period, the defendant never heard that the "Cotton Boll" trademark was the plaintiff's registered trademark. Therefore, it was only from January 1998 that the defendant began to use the "Cotton Boll" pattern on the outer labels of the deltamethrin technical concentrate products it produced, and the quantity used was only 425 kilograms, valued at RMB 95.63. The plaintiff's allegation that the defendant intentionally infringed its exclusive right to use the registered trademark is unfounded; the claim for compensation of RMB 3,000,000 lacks legal basis. The court should dismiss the plaintiff's claims.

After trial, the Nanjing Intermediate People's Court found the following facts:

The "Cotton Boll" pattern trademark was applied for registration on August 30, 1985, with the Trademark Office of the State Administration for Industry and Commerce of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the State Trademark Office) by Roussel Uclaf of France. On February 28, 1997, the State Trademark Office approved the transfer of the registered "Cotton Boll" pattern trademark to the plaintiff, AgrEvo Company, for use on the deltamethrin series products produced by the company. The trademark, after renewal, is valid until August 29, 2005.

The defendant, Nanjing No. 1 Factory, was established and registered on August 15, 1990. On December 5, 1995, Nanjing No. 1 Factory and Nanjing Honghua Plastic Factory jointly initiated the establishment of "Nanjing Red Sun Group Co., Ltd." This company was registered and approved by the Nanjing Administration for Industry and Commerce on March 8, 1996, with validity until December 12, 2005. On March 12, 1998, its name was changed to Red Sun Group Co., Ltd. Red Sun Group Co., Ltd. and Nanjing No. 1 Factory are independent legal persons.

In March 1998, the plaintiff, AgrEvo Company, discovered that the defendant, Nanjing No. 1 Factory, without its permission, had used the registered "Cotton Boll" pattern trademark on the outer packaging labels of its products, and thus initiated this lawsuit.

The defendant, Nanjing No. 1 Factory, admitted that from January 1998 to March 11 of the same year, it used the "Cotton Boll" pattern trademark on the outer packaging labels of the 98% deltamethrin technical concentrate it produced, but denied using the trademark on the outer packaging labels of the 2.5% deltamethrin emulsifiable concentrate (200 liters) products.

Upon the request of the plaintiff, AgrEvo Company, the court conducted an investigation at the Neijiang Agricultural Production Materials General Company in Sichuan Province. In the warehouse of that company, four barrels of 2.5% deltamethrin emulsifiable concentrate (each barrel with a net capacity of 200 liters), produced by the defendant, Nanjing No. 1 Factory, on April 3 and April 6, 1998, were seized. The outer packaging labels of these products all bore the registered "Cotton Boll" trademark pattern. The defendant, Nanjing No. 1 Factory, did not object to this fact. Subsequently, AgrEvo Company did not discover any further use of the "Cotton Boll" trademark pattern by Nanjing No. 1 Factory.

Upon the request of the plaintiff, AgrEvo Company, and in accordance with Article 74 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, the court ordered the seizure of the account books and accounting statements of the defendant, Nanjing No. 1 Factory, and commissioned Jiangsu Audit Firm to audit the actual profits from the sales of 98% deltamethrin technical concentrate and 2.5% deltamethrin emulsifiable concentrate (200 liters) by the factory from January 1998 to the end of April of the same year. The audit concluded that from January to April 1998, Nanjing No. 1 Factory sold a total of 169,470 liters of 2.5% deltamethrin emulsifiable concentrate (200 liters), with revenue of RMB 10,678,610; and sold a total of 890 kilograms of 98% deltamethrin technical concentrate, with revenue of RMB 1,980,550. After deducting expenses, the total actual profit was RMB 678,371.99. Neither party disputed the above audit results.

The above facts are confirmed by the statements of both parties, physical evidence and documentary evidence provided by the plaintiff, AgrEvo Company, the audit report, and evidence collected by the court during investigation.

The Nanjing Intermediate People's Court found that:

Article 3 of the Trademark Law of the People's Republic of China provides: "A trademark approved and registered by the Trademark Office is a registered trademark. The trademark registrant enjoys the exclusive right to use the trademark, which is protected by law." The "Cotton Boll" pattern trademark is a trademark registered with the State Trademark Office. The plaintiff, AgrEvo Company, acquired the exclusive right to use the trademark by law through assignment, and its rights shall be protected by Chinese law. The defendant, Nanjing No. 1 Factory, without the permission of AgrEvo Company, used the registered "Cotton Boll" pattern trademark on the outer packaging of products identical to those of AgrEvo Company, which was sufficient to cause user confusion. Its conduct infringed upon AgrEvo Company's exclusive right to use the registered trademark, violating the provisions of Article 38 of the Trademark Law. Nanjing No. 1 Factory should immediately cease the infringement, publish an apology to AgrEvo Company in a newspaper to eliminate the effects of the infringement, and bear the responsibility for compensating economic losses according to law.

Paragraph 1 of the "Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Issues Concerning the Calculation of Damages for Trademark Infringement and the Period of Infringement" [Fa (Jing) Fu [1985] No. 53] provides: "In cases of infringement of the exclusive right to use a trademark, the infringed party may request compensation based on the actual amount of loss suffered, or may request that the profits obtained by the infringer during the period of infringement due to the infringement (referring to all profits except costs and taxes) be used as the amount of compensation. The infringed party has the right to choose between these two calculation methods." Regarding the economic losses caused to the plaintiff, AgrEvo Company, by the infringing acts of the defendant, Nanjing No. 1 Factory, AgrEvo Company, using the audit report of Tianjin Xietong Accounting Firm as evidence, requested that Nanjing No. 1 Factory be ordered to compensate it for economic losses of RMB 3,000,000. Upon examination, AgrEvo Company is a legal person registered in France, while AgrEvo Tianjin Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of AgrEvo Company, and the two are independent legal persons. The report of Tianjin Xietong Accounting Firm is a conclusion drawn from auditing the sales situation of AgrEvo Tianjin Co., Ltd., which cannot represent the losses suffered by the infringed party, AgrEvo Company, due to the infringement. AgrEvo Company, using the audit report as evidence for its compensation claim and failing to submit other evidence to prove its economic losses caused by the infringement, has insufficient evidence. Therefore, the compensation issue in this case cannot be resolved based on the amount of loss claimed by the infringed party.

Based on the evidence provided by the plaintiff, AgrEvo Company, the defendant, Nanjing No. 1 Factory, admitted during the proceedings that its infringing acts occurred from January to March 1998. Existing evidence also confirms that Nanjing No. 1 Factory still committed infringing acts in April 1998. As to whether there was any infringement after April 1998, Nanjing No. 1 Factory flatly denied it, and AgrEvo Company had no evidence to prove it. Therefore, it is determined that Nanjing No. 1 Factory infringed upon AgrEvo Company's exclusive right to use the registered trademark from January to April 1998. The profits obtained by Nanjing No. 1 Factory during this period from the production and sale of the two products, 2.5% deltamethrin emulsifiable concentrate (200 liters) and 98% deltamethrin technical concentrate, shall, according to law, be compensated to AgrEvo Company as proceeds from the infringement.

The defendant, Nanjing No. 1 Factory, and Red Sun Group Co., Ltd. are independent legal persons from each other. Nanjing No. 1 Factory's use of the "Cotton Boll" trademark to sell its own products is unrelated to Red Sun Group Co., Ltd. The plaintiff, AgrEvo Company's, request to add Red Sun Group Co., Ltd. as a defendant in this case is unfounded.

In summary, the Nanjing Intermediate People's Court rendered the following judgment:

1. The defendant, Nanjing No. 1 Pesticide Factory, shall immediately cease the act of infringing upon the exclusive right to use the registered "Cotton Boll" pattern trademark of the plaintiff, AgrEvo Company;

2. The defendant, Nanjing No. 1 Pesticide Factory, shall compensate the plaintiff, AgrEvo Company, for economic losses in the amount of RMB 678,371.99, to be paid in a lump sum within ten days after this judgment takes effect;

3. The defendant, Nanjing No. 1 Pesticide Factory, shall, within thirty days from the date this judgment takes effect, publish an apology to the plaintiff, AgrEvo Company, in the *Nanjing Daily*.

Court acceptance fee in this case: RMB 25,010; audit fee: RMB 40,000; totaling RMB 65,010, to be borne by the defendant, Nanjing No. 1 Pesticide Factory.

After the first-instance judgment was announced, neither party appealed, and the first-instance judgment became legally effective.
